description: University of Manchester is a public university in Manchester, United Kingdom, welcoming international students across a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate programmes. Students can choose from subjects including computer science, business, engineering, data science and health, with dedicated support for international applicants from application through to arrival. Manchester offers students a welcoming place to live and study, with good transport links and a diverse community.
documents: Passport; Transcript; Certificate; English test result; Statement of purpose; Recommendation letter; CV; Financial document
process_notes: Apply through UCAS for undergraduate courses or directly for postgraduate. After the offer, pay the deposit to receive the CAS, then apply for the Student visa.
subject: Computer Science
